stories.title: Military held on to nearly 70% of sexual offence cases after Ottawa promised transfer to civilian police
stories.summary: CBC reports military police failed to transfer almost 70 per cent of sexual-offence cases over the past five years to civilian police, despite the government committing to do so while working to pass a permanent change into law. Per the Canadian Armed Forces Provost Marshal's office, military authorities investigated 124 of 252 sexual-offence cases reported between December 2021 and August 2023 -- the period immediately after the reform was promised.
stories.connection: DIRECT CFNIS hit -- the single most investigation-relevant story of the scan. The transfer of Criminal Code sexual offences out of military jurisdiction to the civilian justice system was the central recommendation of the Arbour Report (2022), building on the Deschamps Report (2015). 'Military held on to ~70%' is that flagship reform failing in practice -- a documented promise-vs-delivery gap. Maps to cfnis_accountability_dossier.json (Canadian Forces Provost Marshals, Judge Advocates General, CDS Vance/Eyre/Carignan, and the Deschamps/Arbour independent-review bodies), cfnis_command_dossier.json, cfnis_grover_decisionmakers.json, and the enforcement_followthrough.json gap pattern. Recommend a standing 'CFNIS sexual-offence transfer compliance' tracker; confirm the 124/252 figures against the Provost Marshal's published statistics before any use.

stories.title: L3Harris blindsided by Ottawa bypassing competition for surveillance jet contract
stories.summary: A rival bidder for Canada's Arctic surveillance aircraft says it was stunned when Ottawa opened sole-source talks with Saab's GlobalEye, bypassing a formal competition. L3Harris argues its Aeris X would integrate more easily with NORAD and the F-35s, while offering thousands of Canadian jobs and a faster alternative if negotiations falter.
stories.connection: DIRECT procurement-anomaly hit and the THIRD sole-source/rushed-competition defence signal in a week, extending the 'defence procurement velocity' cluster opened in brief_20260622 (Arctic Over-the-Horizon Radar buy from Australia + the navy's 'unusually short' submarine competition). Sole-sourcing a marquee Arctic capability while bypassing a formal competition is the exact pattern tracked in procurement_anomalies.json and arms_pipeline_dossier.json. Maps also to arms_grover_decisionmakers.json, canadian_surface_combatant_grover_decisionmakers.json, defense_nexus.json and revolving_door_analysis.json for industry ties. Sits against Carney's stated 4%-of-GDP-by-2029 defence target (Trump security-call story) -- a rising-budget-plus-sole-sourcing combination. Confirm the Saab/L3Harris shortlist and the sole-source basis against public PSPC/CANSEC records before any use.

stories.title: Battle over 5-figure pay hikes for federal judges is causing unease in legal circles
stories.summary: The federal government and more than 1,000 federally appointed judges are at odds over how to settle an ongoing salary dispute, raising concerns in legal and political circles that the case could tarnish the judiciary's reputation. A judicial-independence and compensation-governance friction point between the executive and the bench.
stories.connection: Logs to judicial_accountability_dossier.json and judicial_grover_decisionmakers.json as an executive-vs-judiciary compensation-governance data point. Medium investigative weight -- relevant as a judicial-independence signal rather than a named-subject hit. Carry forward to watch which parties, counsel and quantum the dispute settles on.

stories.title: Arrest warrant issued for former B.C. correctional officer charged with breach of trust
stories.summary: Naila Sheikh, a former correctional officer at the North Fraser Pretrial Centre in Port Coquitlam, B.C., faces three charges including breach of trust, impersonation and unauthorized use of a government computer. An arrest warrant has been issued in the case.
stories.connection: Corrections-misconduct / breach-of-trust data point mapping to corrections_accountability_dossier.json and corrections_grover_decisionmakers.json. A named state-employee accountability case (provincial corrections) on-theme for the state-accountability mapping. Lower direct federal-mission weight but a concrete breach-of-trust + government-computer-misuse fact pattern worth logging.

stories.title: Carney says donor list for 24 Sussex restoration will be public
stories.summary: Prime Minister Mark Carney said the national fundraising campaign to refurbish the prime minister's official residence at 24 Sussex Drive will cap donations and make the list of donors public to ensure transparency. Media also got a behind-the-scenes tour of the uninhabitable building; a separate Global News piece compares 24 Sussex with G7 official residences.
stories.connection: Public-spending / donor-transparency data point. A national fundraising campaign for a public asset, with a donation cap and a public donor list, is a transparency mechanism worth logging -- particularly the donor list itself once published, for any private-donor / influence cross-reference against public_figure_intelligence.json and contributions_analysis.json. Adjacent to officer_of_parliament_findings.json (expense-scrutiny domain) and the GG-clothing-expense reform logged in brief_20260622. Medium-low weight; flag to revisit when the donor list is released.

stories.title: Feds push to fast-track 3 northern projects (incl. $26B nuclear-waste repository) under Building Canada Act
stories.summary: The federal government wants a Northwest Territories highway, an Arctic deepwater port, and a $26-billion deep geological nuclear-waste repository in northwestern Ontario listed as 'projects of national interest' so their timelines can be accelerated under the Building Canada Act. Some northern leaders welcome the economic boost; others -- including the group We the Nuclear Free North -- call the fast-tracking 'a betrayal of public trust.'
stories.connection: Expedited-approval / process-velocity signal that mirrors the defence-procurement-velocity theme in the infrastructure domain -- accelerating approvals on marquee projects compresses scrutiny. The nuclear-waste repository near Ignace carries an Indigenous-consent dimension; maps to indigenous_accountability_dossier.json and indigenous_grover_decisionmakers.json, with target_priority_matrix.json for prioritization mechanics. Watch for fast-track-without-consultation patterns and which proponents/contractors benefit.
